task_description: Execute full CMS-V2 Reliability Assessment across 6 Work Packages: Plagiarism pipeline coverage and reporting, document extraction BullMQ retry and recovery, institutional authorization enforcement (secretary endorsement gate, phase-3 archival prerequisite, committee composition), architecture documentation alignment, agentic governance restoration, and deterministic verification battery.

work_packages.wp1_baseline: Preflight completed, PTSS index recalled, git status baselined, finding table generated.
work_packages.wp2_plagiarism_coverage: Surgically patched server/jobs/plagiarism.job.js, submission.model.js, plagiarism.model.js, projectTitle.service.js, and client/src/pages/submissions/PlagiarismReportPage.jsx. Differentiated final papers/forced scans from normal drafts. Explicitly persisted scanCoverage (full, lexical_only, degraded), semanticStatus (completed, skipped, failed), and scanType. Strictly rejected degraded scans from archival clearance. Rendered coverage badges and informative warning/guidance banners.
work_packages.wp3_document_extraction_recovery: Surgically patched server/jobs/documentExtraction.job.js and client/src/pages/archive/ExistingCapstoneUploadPage.jsx. Preserved storage files on non-final BullMQ retry attempts, scoped unlinking strictly to temp-extractions, and updated client polling progress check to handle ['active', 'processing'].
work_packages.wp4_institutional_workflow: Removed instructor exemption from secretary endorsement in project.controller.js:1426 and authorize.js:311. Enforced capstonePhase >= 3 prerequisite before archival in projectArchive.service.js. Enforced complete panelist existence and uniqueness in team.service.js:1880.
work_packages.wp5_documentation_governance: Restored 28 tracked .github governance files. Updated README.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with two-stage hybrid plagiarism architecture, circuit breaker resilience, and explicit scan coverage taxonomy.
work_packages.wp6_integration_verification: Passed 100% of targeted client and server suites (13 client tests, 19 server tests), check:endpoints (0 unmatched), validate:agentic (60/60 checks), validate:governance (100%), workspace_guardrail (pristine), and Playwright visual audit across 4 viewports.

verification_evidence.playwright_visual_audit: 4 viewports captured in scratch/ (desktop_light, desktop_dark, mobile_light, mobile_dark) with zero layout shifts or visual regressions

lessons_learned: Lesson: BullMQ worker retries will fail with 404/file not found if temporary storage cleanup runs on attempt 1 of 2. Prevention: Worker cleanup must strictly condition storageService.deleteFile on (attemptsMade >= attempts) and verify key belongs to temp storage.

Lesson: Polling logic must match both BullMQ active state and controller processing state. Checking only jobData.status === 'active' causes progress freezes when controllers cache 'processing' status.

Lesson: Low lexical overlap fast-paths must never present omitted neural checks as full dual-engine clearance. Explicit scanCoverage ('full', 'lexical_only', 'degraded') provides clear auditability and blocks unverified papers from final archival.
Lesson: Secretary compliance endorsement is an institutional gate for all signatories without role exemption; course instructors must not bypass committee endorsements.
